words: h1: Pricing
p: Inspyx is the home inspection app with a voice companion. Here's what the inspectors in our pilot pay.
span: Founding inspector
p: $54.95 a month
p: or $593 a year, and save $66.40
p: For the 10 inspectors in our pilot. Your price stays the same for as long as your plan continues.
a: Join the waitlist
h2: What your plan includes
li: The Inspyx app for iPhone.
li: Spex, the voice companion that takes your notes, photos and findings while you inspect.
li: Reports you send to your clients from your phone.
li: Your templates, agreements, clients and agents, kept in one place.
li: Help by email and phone.
h2: 30 days free
li: Your plan starts with 30 days free, once per inspector. They start when your app invite is sent.
li: Your card is saved when you start. Your first charge comes on the day your free days end, and the app shows that date.
li: We email you a reminder 7 days before your free days end.
li: Cancel before then and you pay nothing.
h2: Faster reports, or three months free
li: Our promise is less time to a finished report.
li: It's measured against your own starting numbers: how long your reports take you today, written down with you when you start.
li: The clock starts when an inspection ends and stops when the finished report is ready to send. Your reports during your 30 free days are timed the same way.
li: If your reports don't take less time, you choose: three months free, or walk away.
li: The promise covers inspection businesses Inspyx sets up. We can only stand behind a setup we did and checked ourselves.
li: It isn't a promise of a certain number of minutes or a certain percentage.
li: To use it, write to support@inspyx.com or call (888) 772-2919.
h2: How billing works
li: You start your plan in the Inspyx app: ☰ → Settings → Your plan.
li: Stripe, our payment processor, takes your card on its secure checkout page. That's where you choose monthly or yearly. Inspyx never sees or stores your card number.
li: Your plan renews automatically every month or every year until you cancel.
li: You get an emailed receipt for every payment.
li: Prices are in US dollars, and don't include sales tax where it applies.
h2: Cancel anytime
li: In the app: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Manage billing, then Cancel subscription.
li: Your plan stays on until the end of the month or year you've paid for, then it stops. Nothing more is charged.
li: Changed your mind after paying? Within 30 days of a payment, you can have it back once: Your plan → Get my money back.
p: The details are in our cancellation and refund policy.
h2: Questions
p: Write to support@inspyx.com or call (888) 772-2919.

words: h1: Cancellation and refunds
p: Last updated: November 16, 2026
h2: Cancel anytime
p: You can cancel your Inspyx plan at any time:
li: In the app: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Manage billing, then Cancel subscription.
li: Or write to support@inspyx.com, or call (888) 772-2919, and we'll cancel it for you.
h2: What happens when you cancel
li: In your free days: your plan ends when they do, and you're never charged.
li: After that: your plan stays on until the end of the month or year you've already paid for, then it stops. Nothing more is charged.
li: Changed your mind? Until that day, you can undo the cancellation in Manage billing.
li: Your inspections stay on your iPhone, and on our servers while your account is open. Canceling doesn't remove them, and you can export them anytime: ☰ → Export.

li: Coming back: you can start a plan again whenever you like. The free days are once per inspector, and the founding price lasts only while a plan continues, so a new plan starts at the price we offer then.
h2: Refunds
p: When you cancel, we don't refund the rest of a month or year you've already paid for. These are the exceptions:

li: Get my money back. Within 30 days of a payment, you can have that whole payment back, once: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Get my money back, or Your plan on our website. Your plan ends at once. Once means once per person: the same email address or card can't have it again on another account.

li: Deleting your account. If you delete your Inspyx account (☰ → Account → Delete your account), your plan ends at once, and we refund the unused whole days of the period you've paid for. The day you delete counts as used. There's nothing to refund in your free days, since nothing was charged.
li: Charges made by mistake. If you're charged twice, or charged after you canceled, we refund that charge in full.
li: Where the law requires a refund.
p: Refunds go back to the card that paid. Your bank usually shows them within 5 to 10 business days.
h2: If a payment doesn't go through
li: You'll get an email, and your card is tried again several times over the next two weeks.
li: You can update your card anytime: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Update card.
li: If the payment still hasn't gone through after two weeks, your plan is canceled. You can start it again anytime.
h2: Questions about a charge
p: Please talk to us before disputing a charge with your bank. Write to support@inspyx.com or call (888) 772-2919, and we'll make it right.
footer: INSPYX LLC · Miami Gardens, FL support@inspyx.com · (888) 772-2919 AboutSupportPricingCancellation and refundsTermsPrivacySign in

words: h1: Terms of Service
p: Last updated: November 25, 2026
h2: 1. Who we are, and what these terms cover

p: Inspyx is made by INSPYX LLC, a Florida company in Miami Gardens, Florida ("Inspyx", "we", "us"). These terms cover the Inspyx app, Spex (its voice companion), the reports, templates and agreements you make with it, and our website. Together, they're "the service".
p: By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy. Questions: support@inspyx.com or (888) 772-2919.
h2: 2. Who can use Inspyx
li: Inspyx is for home inspectors and inspection companies in the United States. You must be at least 18.
li: If you use Inspyx for a company, you confirm that you may accept these terms for it.
li: Your account is for you alone. Keep your sign-in safe, and tell us at once if you think someone else has used it.
h2: 3. Your plan and payments
li: Price. Inspectors in our pilot pay the founding price: $54.95 a month or $593 a year. It stays the same for as long as your plan continues.

li: 30 days free. Your first plan starts with 30 days free, once per inspector, from when your app invite is sent. Your card is saved when you start, and it's first charged when your free days end, unless you cancel before then. We email you a reminder 7 days before.
li: Renewal. Your plan renews automatically, every month or every year, until you cancel. By starting a plan, you authorize us to charge your card through Stripe each time it renews.
li: Payments are handled by Stripe. Your card goes to Stripe directly; we never see or store it.
li: Prices are in US dollars, and don't include sales tax where it applies.
li: Canceling. Cancel anytime in the app (☰ → Settings → Your plan → Manage billing). Your plan runs to the end of the period you've paid for. Refunds follow our cancellation and refund policy.
li: Failed payments. If a payment doesn't go through, your card is tried again over two weeks. If it still hasn't gone through, your plan is canceled.
li: Price changes. We'll tell you at least 30 days before any change to what you pay, and it applies from your next renewal. Your founding price doesn't change while your plan continues.
li: Extras. Anything you add to your plan later shows its price before you add it.
h2: 4. Your content belongs to you
li: You own your inspections, reports, photos, notes, templates, agreements, and your clients' and agents' details ("your content").
li: You allow us to store, process and send your content only to run the service for you, including through the service providers named in our Privacy Policy.
li: We never sell your content, use your clients' details to market to them, or use your content to advertise.
li: You can export your content at any time: ☰ → Export.
h2: 5. Your inspections and reports are your professional work
li: Inspyx is a tool. It doesn't inspect anything, and it doesn't give engineering, legal or other professional advice.

li: You decide what goes in your reports. Review everything before you send it, including what Spex records, files or suggests; labels and serial numbers read from photos; measurements and levels taken with the camera; and property facts, weather, Street View and images from above. Those come from public records and outside services, and they can be wrong or out of date.
li: Your agreement with your clients is between you and them. Make sure it meets your state's rules. Any sample agreement text in Inspyx is a starting point, not legal advice.
li: If you use your booking page or online signing, you're responsible for your agreement's words and for what your page offers. Inspyx sends and keeps them for you.

li: You confirm that you may collect, use and share your clients' and agents' details and photos. You follow the laws that apply to your work, including your license, your standards of practice and privacy laws.
h2: 6. Spex and other AI features
li: Spex uses artificial intelligence (Google's Gemini service, through our servers). It can mishear, and it can make mistakes.
li: Spex listens only while it's on, and you can turn it off at any time.
h2: 7. Using Inspyx fairly
p: Don't:
li: use the service for anything illegal, or to mislead or harm anyone;
li: share your account, or resell the service;
li: try to get into parts of the service, or other people's data, that aren't yours;
li: copy, take apart or reverse-engineer the app, except where the law allows it;
li: overload the service or interfere with it, including with automated tools;
li: use Spex to impersonate someone or to make harmful content.
p: We may suspend or close an account that breaks these rules. Where we reasonably can, we'll tell you first and give you a chance to fix it.
h2: 8. The pilot
li: Inspyx is new, and it changes often. During the pilot, features can change, be added or be removed. Something may break, and we'll fix it fast.
li: Your inspections are saved on your iPhone, and on our servers while your account is open. Export them regularly, so a lost phone doesn't lose your work.
li: Inspyx measures your times (time on site, time to the report) on your phone. Sharing them with us is your choice. We name you or quote you only with your written OK.
li: You're welcome to send us ideas and problem reports. We may use them freely, with nothing owed.
h2: 9. Other companies' services

p: Inspyx works with services from other companies, including Apple, Google, Stripe, Supabase, RentCast, the U.S. Census Bureau, the National Weather Service and NOAA. Their own terms may also apply to you. We aren't responsible for their services, and they can change.
h2: 10. Apple

p: The app is licensed to you, not sold. These terms are between you and Inspyx, not Apple, and Apple isn't responsible for the app or its support. Apple's standard license terms for apps also apply. Where they conflict with these terms, these terms govern, as far as Apple allows.
h2: 11. No guarantees

p: The service is provided "as is" and "as available". We work to keep it running, accurate and safe. We don't promise that it will always be available, free of errors, or right for a particular purpose. The app works on your phone without a connection; features that use our servers, such as Spex and property lookups, need one. The one promise we make on top of this is the faster-reports promise on our pricing page, on the conditions written there.
h2: 12. Limits on our responsibility
p: As far as the law allows:
li: Inspyx isn't responsible for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits, lost data, or claims about an inspection.
li: Inspyx's total responsibility for any claim is limited to the greater of what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, or $100.
p: Some states don't allow some of these limits. Where they don't apply, our responsibility is limited as far as those states allow.
h2: 13. Claims about your work

p: If someone (a client, an agent or anyone else) makes a claim against Inspyx about your inspections or reports, your agreements with your clients, your content, or your breaking these terms, you'll cover Inspyx's reasonable costs of that claim, including legal fees.
h2: 14. Ending your account
li: You can stop using Inspyx and cancel your plan at any time. Canceling leaves your inspections on your iPhone.

li: You can delete your account in the app: ☰ → Account → Delete your account. That ends your plan at once, refunds the unused days you've paid for, and removes your records from our servers, as our Privacy Policy says. Inspections saved on your iPhone stay on it until you delete the app.
li: Sections 4 and 11 to 15 still apply after your account ends.
h2: 15. Changes, the law, and disputes

li: Changes. We'll post changes to these terms on this page. For a change that matters, we'll tell you in the app or by email at least 30 days before it takes effect. If you keep using Inspyx after that, you accept the change.
li: The law. These terms are governed by Florida law.

li: Disputes. Before going to court, write to support@inspyx.com, and we'll try to settle it within 30 days. Disputes go to the state or federal courts in Miami-Dade County, Florida. Either side may use small-claims court instead, where it qualifies.
h2: 16. Text messages about an inspection
p: Inspyx sends text messages for the home inspectors who use it, to their clients who ask for them. These terms cover those texts.

li: What you get. Texts about your own inspection, sent by Inspyx for your home inspector: appointment confirmations, reminders, and report and payment notices. About 5 to 8 texts per inspection. No marketing.
li: How you join. By ticking "OK to text me about this inspection" on your inspector's booking page. The box is unticked unless you tick it, and you don't need to agree to texts to book.
li: Costs. Message and data rates may apply, from your mobile carrier.
li: Stopping. Reply STOP to any text to stop all texts from this number. You'll get one text confirming it, and no more after that. Reply HELP for help, or write to support@inspyx.com.
li: Your number. We use it only to text you about your inspection, and we never share it for anyone's marketing. See our Privacy Policy.
li: Carriers aren't responsible for texts that are delayed or not delivered.

words: h1: Privacy Policy
p: Last updated: November 26, 2026
h2: Who we are
p: Inspyx is made by INSPYX LLC, Miami Gardens, Florida. Questions about privacy: support@inspyx.com or (888) 772-2919.
h2: Who this covers
li: Home inspectors who use the Inspyx app or our website.
li: The people in their inspections (clients, real estate agents and others), whose details an inspector enters or a client enters on an inspector's booking page.
li: Clients who sign an agreement, pay or open a report through Inspyx, and people who call an inspector's Mia line.
li: Visitors to inspyx.com and callers to our own phone line.

p: The inspector decides what to record about their clients and agents, and how to use it. Inspyx handles that information for the inspector, to provide the service. Inspectors own their client relationships, and we never sell anyone's data.
h2: What we collect, and why

li: Your account. Your name, email address and sign-in, handled by our sign-in provider, Supabase. If you sign in with Apple or Google, they tell us your name and email address. We never see your password, and Face ID stays on your iPhone. If you sign in with Apple, we keep the token Apple gives us, only so that deleting your account also ends Inspyx's access at Apple. We note the day you agreed to our Terms and this policy, and how you first signed in. You can add business details (your license number, logo, photo and signature), which print on your reports. Your company details, picture, logo, signature, agreements, templates and price list are kept on Inspyx's servers.

li: Your inspections. Property addresses and details; your clients' and agents' names, phone numbers and emails; findings, notes, answers and photos (photos can show the inside of a home); your client's signature on your agreement; and your fee for the inspection, whether it's paid, and payments you record. These are saved on your iPhone and kept on our servers too, so you can see and finish them at inspyx.com, or on another iPhone or iPad signed in to your account. Your iPhone also keeps a private copy of all of it, photo and video files included, in your account's own folder in our file store (at Supabase), so a lost or replaced iPhone never means a lost inspection: sign in on the new one and bring them back. The same folder brings an inspection's photo and video files to your other iPhone or iPad, so both show the same inspection. Nothing in it goes to anyone else's account or device. Copies go over Wi-Fi, or over mobile data only if you allow it. Photo and video files otherwise leave your iPhone only when you share or export them, or when a feature below sends what it needs to do its job.
li: Your inspections on the website. So you can see your inspections, calendar and the people on them on inspyx.com, their details are kept on Inspyx's servers with your account.

li: People you keep. The clients and agents you keep in People (their names, phone numbers, emails, companies and your notes about them) are kept on Inspyx's servers with your account, so they show on the website as well as in the app, and they're removed when you delete your account.

li: Inspections from the app you used before. When you bring in your past inspections, we keep each one's date, address, client and the client's email and phone, agents, fee, services, inspector, order number and notes, and where it came from, on Inspyx's servers with your account, so they show on the website as well as in the app. They're removed when you delete your account.

li: Bringing your data in. When you bring in a file of your clients, agents or past inspections on the website, your browser reads it there: the file itself is never sent to us, only the people and inspections you choose to keep. To bring them in straight from Spectora, you paste your own Spectora API key. In the app, your iPhone asks Spectora directly. On the website, our server asks Spectora for each page and passes it to your browser without keeping it. Your key is used only for those requests: we never keep it or write it down. So no one can use our website to flood Spectora, our server counts how many requests your account makes each hour, never what they carry, and the count is removed when you delete your account.

li: Your booking page. If you turn on your booking page, your clients can book you at inspyx.com/book/your-name. They see your name, company, services, prices and open times. We work out your open times from the hours you set and your inspections' times only (when each starts and ends, never the address or the client). When a client books, we keep what they enter (their name, email, phone, the property's address and details, and the services they pick) and send it to your app. Booking emails (and Inspyx's other automatic emails) go out through Amazon's email service. We note whether each one was delivered, bounced or marked as spam, so you can see it reached them. If they stop partway, we keep what they entered for 30 days so you can follow up.

li: Agreements signed online. When a client books, we email them your agreement to sign on their phone or computer. We keep the exact text they were sent, their initials and drawn signature, their typed name, when they signed, their device's browser name, and a scrambled form of their internet address, so the signature can be shown to be theirs. The signed copy (a PDF) is emailed to them and to you, and kept on our servers while your account is open. We remind a client to sign only while they haven't, at most three times, and never after the inspection starts.

li: Reports you send. When you send a report, your client gets a private link to it at inspyx.com. We keep the report there while your account is open, and note when the link is first and last opened, so you can see your client has it. On their report link, your client or their agent can list the repairs or credits they want for its findings. We keep their list with the report, and any copy they choose to share at inspyx.com/repair. They send it themselves; Inspyx sends nothing.

li: Card payments from your clients. If you take card payments, your client pays on Stripe's page, into your own Stripe account. Stripe receives their card; we never see it. We keep what was paid, when, and for which inspection, so your app and the website can show it.

li: Texts to your clients. Only to a client who agreed to texts, and only about their own inspection. Texts go out through Amazon's text service, from Inspyx's number on your behalf. We keep each text and when it was sent.

li: Mia, your phone line. If you turn on Mia for your business, calls to your Mia number are answered by Mia through Retell, our phone service, which turns the call into words so Mia can answer. We keep each call's time and length (for your minutes) and the message Mia takes: the caller's name and number, why they called, and any address, services or times they mention. Mia sends that message to you.

li: Emails you forward. If you forward a client's email to your Inspyx address (your-name@book.inspyx.com), we keep its sender, subject and words for 90 days so Spex can draft your reply. Attachments aren't kept. Amazon holds the email itself only until we've kept its words, and never longer than 7 days. Spex only drafts: nothing is sent until you tap Send.

li: Spex, the voice companion. While Spex is on, what you say, and any photo you show Spex, goes through our server to Google's Gemini service, so Spex can understand and answer. Our server keeps a usage record for each session (your account, how long it ran, and what it cost us), not the audio or the words. The captions stay on your phone. Spex listens only while it's on, and you can turn it off at any time.

li: Spex Chat and Spex's writing help. When you type to Spex, or ask it to rewrite a finding (in the app or on the website), an email or a text, check a label's details, or convert a template, what you send goes through our server to Google's Gemini service, which writes the answer. Nothing changes until you keep it. Your chats stay on your iPhone. Our server keeps a usage record (your account, and what it cost us), not your words.

li: Property lookups. When you choose an address, our server sends it to public-record, weather and map services to fill in the inspection: RentCast (property facts), the U.S. Census Bureau's address service, the National Weather Service, NOAA and the Aviation Weather Center (the weather when you start), and Google (Street View and the view from above). Address suggestions while you type come from Apple Maps, through your iPhone.

li: Crash reports. If the app breaks, a report of where and why goes to Inspyx's own server, hosted by Supabase. We leave out your name, and remove email addresses and phone numbers. We keep each report for up to 90 days. You can turn this off: ☰ → Settings → Send crash reports.
li: Your plan. Billing runs through Stripe. Stripe receives your email address and card; we never see or store card numbers. We keep your plan's status, dates and price.

li: Your numbers. Inspyx works out how long each inspection took (time on site, time to the report) on your iPhone. If you tick "Be a founding inspector" when you sign up, your app sends Inspyx these numbers for each inspection you finish in your first month: when it started, when you were last on site, when the report was made and shared, and how many findings (and how many Spex added), photos and items it has. Never a client's name, an address, or anything your report says. After your first month, nothing more is sent. If you don't tick the box, nothing leaves your phone unless you export it.

li: Try Spex on our website. If you try Spex on inspyx.com, what you say goes through our server to Google's Gemini service, so Spex can answer. We keep no recording and no words. To keep the demo fair, our server keeps a scrambled form of your internet address for the day.

li: Our website and phone line. If you apply for the pilot on our website (the form is a Google form) or call our phone line, we keep your name, contact details and what you tell us, so we can answer you. If you join the waitlist on our website, we keep your email address, the two answers you tap, and which page and which ad or link brought you, so we can write to you when the pilot opens. Our phone line is answered by Mia, an AI receptionist, through a service called Retell. Our website uses no cookies and no ad trackers.
h2: How we use it
li: To run Inspyx for you: your inspections, reports, bookings, agreements, payments, texts, emails, Mia and Spex.
li: To help you when you ask us, and to keep accounts safe and stop abuse.
li: To make Inspyx better: from crash reports, and from patterns across many inspectors, never by reading one inspector's records for their own sake.
li: To tell you about Inspyx: emails about your account and plan, which you always get, and news about Inspyx, which you can stop with the link in any of them.
li: To show what Inspyx does: we may publish totals and averages from founders' numbers (for example, "founders finished their reports 40% faster"), never naming you or your clients.
li: Testimonials: we use your name, company, picture or words in our marketing only if you say yes, and we stop if you change your mind.
h2: What we never do
li: Sell anyone's data.
li: Use your clients' details to market to them.
li: Use your inspection data to advertise.
li: Let our AI provider train its models on what you send: Google handles it for us under terms that don't allow that.

li: Sell anyone's mobile number or their OK to receive texts, or share either with third parties for marketing. A client's number and their text consent are used only to send texts about their own inspection, from Inspyx's number on their inspector's behalf. When someone agrees to texts on a booking page, we keep the words they agreed to, when, and a scrambled form of their internet address, as proof of their consent. Replying STOP ends the texts.
h2: Who we share with

li: Our service providers, each only for its part: Supabase (our database, file store and sign-in), Google Cloud (Spex and Gemini, Street View and the view from above), Amazon Web Services (emails and texts), Stripe (your plan, and your clients' card payments), Retell (Mia's calls), Vercel (our website), Apple (sign-in with Apple and address suggestions), RentCast and the public address and weather services named above, and Google Forms (the pilot form).
li: People you choose to send things to, such as a report you share.

li: Real estate agents you email a report to. When you email a report to someone as their agent, Inspyx gives that agent a private link to one page listing the reports you have emailed to that same address: each property's address and date, and the report. It shows only what you already sent them, and you can turn it off at any time. To stop anyone guessing an agent page's private link, our server keeps a scrambled form of the visitor's internet address for up to a day, then deletes it.
li: A buyer of the business: if INSPYX LLC is ever merged or sold, your information moves with it, and this policy still applies to it.
li: Anyone the law requires us to.
h2: Where it's kept
p: Inspyx's servers, and our providers' for the parts they handle, are in the United States.
h2: How long we keep it
li: On your iPhone: until you delete it, delete your account, or delete the app.

li: On our servers: while your account is open. When you delete your account, we remove your account and your records from our servers right away. We keep only what the law or our accounts require: Stripe's billing records, a record of any refund, and Spex usage records. If Apple won't yet take back a sign-in token, we keep that token, naming no account, only until Apple does. If you get your money back, we keep a scrambled form of your email address and card even after your account is deleted, only so the same person can't get a second refund.

li: Booking pages: a booking someone started but didn't finish, 30 days; finished bookings and signed agreements, while your account is open; forwarded emails, 90 days. To stop anyone scraping a booking page, our server keeps a scrambled form of the visitor's internet address for up to a day.
li: Mia's calls and messages, your numbers, and reports you send: while your account is open. Totals and averages already worked out from founders' numbers name no one, so they stay.
li: Crash reports: up to 90 days.
h2: Your choices
li: Turn crash reports off: ☰ → Settings → Send crash reports.
li: Turn Spex off at any time.
li: Export everything: ☰ → Export.
li: Delete your account in the app: ☰ → Account → Delete your account.
li: Ask us to see, correct or delete your information: support@inspyx.com.
li: Stop Inspyx's news emails with the link in any of them.
li: Take back a yes to a testimonial: write to support@inspyx.com.
h2: Your rights

p: Wherever you live, you can ask us what information we hold about you, for a copy of it, to correct it, or to delete it, and you won't be treated differently for asking. Write to support@inspyx.com. We answer within 45 days, and we may need to confirm it's you first. We don't sell personal information, or share it for advertising that follows you around the web.
h2: Security
li: Data on your iPhone is protected by the iPhone's own encryption.
li: Connections to our servers are encrypted.
li: Every change to an inspection is kept in a tamper-evident record, and a signed agreement keeps the exact text that was signed.
li: No system is perfectly secure. Tell us at once if you think someone else has used your account.
h2: Children
p: Inspyx is for professionals, and it isn't meant for children under 13. We don't knowingly collect their information.

h2: Who we are
p: Inspyx is made by INSPYX LLC, a Florida company based in Miami Gardens, Florida.
p: The company was founded in 2026 by Moises Avila, a licensed Florida home inspector.
h2: What we make
p: Inspyx is an iPhone app for home inspectors, with a voice companion.

li: Spex is the companion you talk to during an inspection. You say what you see, and Spex takes the photo, marks it and files the finding in the right room. Every finding goes straight into the report.
li: Mia is a voice receptionist. She answers the phone, answers the usual questions and books the job on your calendar.
li: Spex Business handles the requests that come in by email or through the form on your website.
h2: Where we are today
p: Inspyx is getting ready for a pilot with its first 10 inspectors. Spex works today. Mia and Spex Business arrive with the pilot.
p: If you are a home inspector and would like to take part, you can join the waitlist.

words: h1: Support
h2: Contact us
li: Email: support@inspyx.com
li: Phone: (888) 772-2919. Mia, our voice receptionist, answers. She can take a message or connect you.
p: We answer every message, usually within one business day.
h2: Your plan and billing
li: See or change your plan in the app: ☰ → Settings → Your plan.
li: Update your card: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Update card.
li: Cancel: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Manage billing, then Cancel subscription. Or ask us, and we'll cancel it for you.
p: What happens when you cancel, and when we refund, is in our cancellation and refund policy. Prices are on the pricing page.
h2: Your account
li: Forgot your password? Contact us and we will start a reset for you.
li: Delete your account: in the app, ☰ → Account → Delete your account.
h2: Your data
p: Your inspections stay on your iPhone, and on our servers while your account is open. You can export them anytime: ☰ → Export.
p: What we collect and what we never do is in our privacy policy. The rules for using Inspyx are in our terms.
h2: Report a problem
p: Write to support@inspyx.com and tell us:
li: what you were doing when it happened,
li: what you expected, and what happened instead,
li: your iPhone model.
p: A screenshot or a screen recording helps us most.
